initialExam.title: Assam Police Constable 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: State Level Police Recruitment Board (SLPRB), Assam
initialExam.description: Assam Police Constable recruitment through SLPRB for AB and UB constable posts in Assam state police.
initialExam.eligibility: HSLC (10th pass) from a recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Current Affairs, Assam GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English, Assamese/Bengali/Bodo.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. Physical Standard Test. PET.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → PST/PET → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit slprbassam.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension
